name: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Everyday Wonders
summary: Dive into something wonderful! Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket’s latest expansion, Everyday Wonders, is now available on Pokémon TCG Pocket. Swipe on over to start opening booster packs from this expansion overflowing with cuteness. Pikachu, Piplup, Snorlax, Greedent, and Sylveon are the stars of this adorable show.
